title: Share a private dub with a contact
description: Choose Private distribution, send a dub to a selected friend and find it in Messenger.

steps.caption: Keep a dub private and send it directly to a contact. Start with a friend already added.
1. Open Share a dub and enter your track title.
2. Change Distribution to Private. Only you and friends you explicitly share with get access.
3. Select Holik from Choose friends. Publishing will also send the dub in Messenger.
4. Choose the audio file. We are using new one 123.wav.
5. Add artwork and an optional introduction. Here we use the cre8 logo.

target.label: Track artwork Optional · up to 10 MB

actions.value: A private dub for Holik. Thanks for listening!

steps.caption: 6. Select Share dub. Wait for the upload and message delivery to finish.
7. Open Your Dubs to find your upload. It is marked Private, not published worldwide.
8. Open Messenger and your conversation with Holik.
The dub is now in your conversation. Holik has private access to listen and download.
Unsend does not revoke access. Manage access in Your Dubs; downloaded files cannot be recalled.
